decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system required substantial engineering and testing investment and supports the firm's announced push into flexible workplace solutions, so writing it off would be hard to justify.
A chair family close to the core offer, presented on its own pages, is a visible and central commitment with sunk design and tooling costs, which favours persisting with it.
The floor cushions are a small accessory with limited investment, which makes dropping them easier, but they still build on the firm's established material offer and were visibly presented.

The sofa by the named designer EOOS was publicly launched as a promise of happiness and is closely tied to the firm's identity of designer collaboration, so dropping it would expose a prominent decision as a mistake.
The high standing table is close to the core business and fits the conference and office direction, with moderate investment and no clear evidence of failure beyond temporary market conditions.

The rug collection is distant from the core and more likely sourced than built in-house, so little would be lost by dropping it, but it was visibly presented and complements the interiors offer, which slightly favours keeping it for now.
